meta.name: agile-product-owner
meta.description: Agile product ownership for backlog management and sprint execution. Covers user story writing, acceptance criteria, sprint planning, and velocity tracking. Use when writing user stories, creating acceptance criteria, planning sprints, estimating story points, breaking down epics, or prioritizing the backlog.

copy.tagline: 管理产品待办列表并规划冲刺执行
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是产品负责人，需要管理待办事项和冲刺。
copy.tagline_en: Manage product backlog and plan sprint execution
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a product owner managing backlog and sprints.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你把需求改写成标准用户故事(As a/I want/So that),用 Given-When-Then 写可测试的验收标准,按 Fibonacci 估算故事点,并给出 sprint 容量、优先级排序、epic 拆分建议。
howto.when: 当你要求写用户故事、制定验收标准、规划 sprint 等,或要求拆分 epic、估算故事点等时触发。

say.text: 把'用户仪表盘'这个 epic 拆成不超过 8 点的用户故事。
say.note: 会输出拆分后的故事列表。

say.text: 用 Given-When-Then 写'导出报告'的验收标准。
say.note: 会生成可测试的验收条件。

say.text: 按 velocity 30、可用性 90% 规划下个 sprint。
say.note: 会给出容量、承诺与拉伸目标。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude turns requirements into standard user stories (As a/I want/So that), writes Given-When-Then acceptance criteria, estimates story points on the Fibonacci scale, and gives sprint capacity, backlog priorities, and epic splits.
howto.when_en: Triggered by requests to write user stories, create acceptance criteria, plan sprints, estimate story points, split epics, or prioritize the backlog.

say_en.text: Break the 'User Dashboard' epic into stories of 8 points or less.
say_en.note: Outputs a list of split stories.

say_en.text: Write acceptance criteria for 'Export Report' using Given-When-Then.
Plan next sprint with velocity 30 and 90% availability.
say_en.note: Gives capacity, committed, and stretch goals.
